name: yt-resume
description: A local-first Firefox and Chromium extension that resumes standard YouTube videos.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run prepare:dist -- firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chromium
scripts.build:firefox: npm run prepare:dist -- firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:chromium: npm run prepare:dist -- chromium && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts/chromium --overwrite-dest
